description: This file defines classes and methods related to delivery carriers, delivery grids, and delivery grid lines in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including price calculation logic based on order details and delivery grid rules.

classes.name: delivery_carrier
classes.description: Represents a delivery carrier with associated delivery grids and price calculation.

classes.name: delivery_grid
classes.description: Defines delivery pricing rules based on order totals, weight, and volume.

classes.name: delivery_grid_line
classes.description: Represents individual rule lines within a delivery grid, used for price calculation conditions.

methods.name: get_price
methods.description: Calculates the price for a delivery carrier based on the order and context.

methods.name: grid_get
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate delivery grid ID based on contact address and carrier.

methods.name: get_price
methods.description: Calculates the delivery price based on order details, using the associated delivery grid.

methods.name: get_price_from_picking
methods.description: Calculates delivery price based on total, weight, and volume, applying grid line rules.
